report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We regret to inform you that your application is not moving forward. This is because your CV does not meet several required qualifications: data science experience of at least 4 years (only 3 years shown), understanding of Bayesian methods or time series analysis, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (e.g., Pyro, PyMC3), experience with Amazon SageMaker, experience with PySpark, or strong working knowledge of SQL.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
